title: [BW] Better Whispers
description: This mod enhances the Minecraft chat (/msg) experience
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9844561700463a86ae0202b4d0c5c861b078cb10.png)

**Better Whispers** is a minecraft mod aimed at improving the minecraft /msg (whisper experience) for **1.21.11-26.1**
> Recommended for the vanilla chat, as custom chat plugins aren't fully supported yet!
# Requirements:
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

# How to use:

Upon installing the mod you will notice 2 things when you first open the chat interface

### 1st thing is chat filters
![filters](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce7ee60f95857974cc23cee3a762bcbf54e49183.png)

Chat filters allow you to better find what you need in chat by only focusing on the type of message you're interested in.

## 2nd thing is a little conversations buttons
![Conversations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e553c2c7a7fb546e30d5f705e1c60ced08169fa.png)

This button is the gateway to the main interface of the mod:

![Main UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8abb068d282013ff6b7e6dc6f6cab9b674cd433f_0.webp)

this ui allows you to see your whisper history as well as separate conversations into a clean social media like ui. it supports (whispers/msg & teammsg)
> _If you encounter any issues with the mod Contact me over on [Discord](https://discord.gg/NvWWCMz83P)_
